title: Bearings: Self-Supervised Soundfield Embeddings from First-Order Ambisonics
abstract: arXiv:2609.23152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recently proposed self-supervised audio encoders learn powerful general-purpose representations of sound scenes, yet they are spatially blind. To supply the missing spatial representation of sound scenes, we introduce Bearings. Bearings is a self-supervised framework that learns soundfield embeddings from unlabeled first-order Ambisonics. We pre-train a masked auto-encoder paired with a decoder conditioned on frozen acoustic embeddings from an off-the-shelf single-channel audio encoder. Our results show that the resulting soundfield embeddings form a reusable stream that can be attached to frozen acoustic encoders with a lightweight trainable fusion head. On sound event localization and detection, concatenating our soundfield embeddings with acoustic representations provides the missing spatial information and enables joint detection and localization, raising the location-dependent F-score from below 4 to 50 on TAU-NIGENS 2021 and 39 o

translated_title: Bearings：基于一阶Ambisonics的自监督声场嵌入
translated_abstract: 最近提出的自监督音频编码器能够学习到强大的通用声场景表示，但它们在空间上是“盲”的。为了补充声场景所缺失的空间表示，我们提出了Bearings。Bearings是一个自监督框架，可以从无标签的一阶Ambisonics中学习声场嵌入。我们预训练了一个掩码自编码器，其配对的解码器以现成的单通道音频编码器输出的冻结声学嵌入为条件。我们的结果表明，所得到的声场嵌入形成了一个可复用的数据流，可以通过轻量级可训练的融合头附加到冻结的声学编码器上。在声音事件定位与检测任务中，将我们的声场嵌入与声学表示拼接起来可以提供缺失的空间信息，实现联合检测与定位，在TAU-NIGENS 2021数据集上将依赖位置的F分数从低于4提升到50，并在另一数据集上提升到39。
tldr: 提出了Bearings自监督框架，从无标签一阶Ambisonics中学习声场嵌入，可与冻结的声学编码器轻量级融合，将声音事件定位与检测的位置相关F分数从低于4大幅提升至50。
en_tdlr: Bearings is a self-supervised framework that learns soundfield embeddings from unlabeled first-order Ambisonics, which can be attached to frozen acoustic encoders via a lightweight fusion head to dramatically improve sound event localization and detection, raising the location-dependent F-score from below 4 to 50.
